value.rationale: The entire unimodular coefficient circle is optimized globally (not just ± signs), with rigid minimizing and maximizing phases for every open exponent in an infinite degree regime and an explicit exponential cosine-profile estimate. This is a natural quantitative refinement of the sharp three-term majorant problem, with stable near-extremal phase information; the method threshold is not asserted sharp.
